name: CarouselCard
title: Listing card with image carousel
description: A bordered card whose header is a looping image carousel with hover-reveal controls and expanding dot indicators, above a title, rating, description, price, and book button. Requires importing `@mantine/carousel/styles.css` once. Use for property, product, or listing detail cards.

i18nKeys.carouselcard__description: Relax, rejuvenate and unplug in this unique contemporary Birdbox. Feel close to nature in ultimate comfort. Enjoy the view of the epic mountain range of Blegja and the Førdefjord.
